controls.name: C-14d
controls.query:
FROM .internal.alerts-security.alerts-default-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-07-12T19:02:22.000Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-12T20:02:22.000Z"
        AND host.name == "web-1"
| STATS events = COUNT(*)
        BY kibana.alert.rule.name, kibana.alert.severity
| SORT events DESC
| LIMIT 20
